metadata.title: SSPP Template - Email Campaign Platform
metadata.remarks: Architecture-driven SSPP template for an institutional Email Bulk Messaging Gateway. This SSPP defines system purpose, trust dependencies, data authority boundaries, recipient and content constraints, separation of duties, governance accountability, and enforceable usage boundaries.

import-profile.remarks: Institutional baseline including security, privacy, data governance, and regulatory overlays.

system-characteristics.system-description: Institutional outbound email campaign service used for authorized, high-volume communications to students, staff, faculty, and public stakeholders.

props.name: primary-pattern
props.remarks: This system implements the Email Bulk Messaging Gateway solution pattern.

props.name: usage-constraint
props.remarks: This system is authorized for planned, approved outbound email campaigns only. It MUST NOT be used for ad-hoc, emergency, transactional, or personal messaging.

props.name: recipient-scope
props.remarks: Outbound email campaigns may target students, staff, faculty, and public stakeholders only.

props.name: recipient-constraint
props.remarks: Recipients MUST be individual email addresses. Shared mailboxes, role-based or application mailboxes, distribution lists, and listservs are explicitly prohibited.

props.name: content-classification-constraint
props.remarks: Email message content MUST contain Level-1 (public) information only. Sensitive or higher-classification data MUST NOT be included in message bodies.

props.name: data-sensitivity
props.remarks: The system processes PII including individual email addresses, engagement telemetry, opt-out state, and campaign interaction data.

props.name: data-sensitivity
props.remarks: Campaign configuration, audience composition, analytics, and delivery metrics constitute sensitive institutional data.

props.name: data-authority
props.remarks: Identity, primary email address, and consent eligibility are ingested as certified copies from authoritative systems under institutional data sharing agreements.

props.name: data-authority
props.remarks: This system is the authoritative source for opt-out (suppression) status, campaign execution history, recipient targeting, and delivery outcomes.

props.name: consent-enforcement
props.remarks: The system enforces opt-out decisions and suppression lists and MUST NOT re-enroll recipients or override consent determinations received from authoritative sources.

props.name: branding-constraint
props.remarks: Sender identities (from-addresses) MUST receive explicit branding and communications approval prior to being enabled for outbound campaigns.

props.name: tenant-isolation
props.remarks: Campaign configuration, recipient data, audit records, and sender identities are logically isolated per account and are not accessible across accounts.

props.name: audit-evidence-availability
props.remarks: Audit records related to campaign authorization, sending, opt-out enforcement, and delivery outcomes are retained in accordance with institutional records retention schedules.

props.name: records-and-retention-governance
props.remarks: Retention durations and disposal requirements are defined by authoritative institutional and regulatory sources and implemented through inherited records-and-retention capabilities.

system-implementation.remarks: The system implementation binds architectural intent to institutional solution, trust, data, and regulatory patterns. Patterns are normative; instantiated SSPPs bind these assertions to concrete platforms and evidence.

components.title: Email Bulk Messaging Gateway
components.description: Primary solution capability governing authorization, consent alignment, abuse prevention, auditability, delivery tracking, and reputational protection for bulk email campaigns.

components.title: Institutional Data Trust
components.description: Institutional data governance foundations including ownership, classification, handling rules, and records retention.

links.remarks: The system consumes certified data and enforces handling and retention rules without assuming system-of-record authority.

components.title: Regulated Digital Service Obligations
components.description: Compliance with accessibility, branding, communications, disclosure, and jurisdictional requirements.

control-implementation.remarks: Controls are satisfied through referenced solution and trust patterns and inherited shared services. This SSPP intentionally does not restate control narratives or implementation procedures.

roles.title: Account Owner
roles.description: Accountable for the lifecycle, governance, and financing of the email campaign account. Responsibilities include requesting role assignments via the institutional identity system, performing periodic access reviews and attestations, requesting sender identity (from-address) enablement, requesting account decommissioning when no longer required, and accepting financial responsibility for account operation and cross-billing. This role does not perform campaign operations or platform administration.

roles.title: Campaign Author
roles.description: Creates draft campaign content and defines intended recipient scope. This role cannot approve or send campaigns.

roles.title: Campaign Manager
roles.description: Reviews and approves campaign content and messaging intent for compliance with institutional communications requirements prior to authorization.

roles.title: Branding / Communications Approver
roles.description: Reviews and approves sender identities (from-addresses) and associated branding before enabling them for outbound campaign use.

roles.title: Campaign Sender
roles.description: Authorized to initiate sending of campaigns that have completed all required approvals.

roles.title: Platform Administrator (ITS)
roles.description: Performs centralized platform configuration, maintenance, and enforcement as part of institutional service operations. This role is not delegated to tenants and does not participate in campaign authoring, approval, or sending.
